introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: At Nootiq, we are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our services.

data_collection.title: Information we collect
data_collection.content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, upload documents, or contact us. We also automatically collect information about your use of our services.

data_usage.title: How we use your information
data_usage.purpose2: Process your documents and generate study materials
data_usage.purpose3: Communicate with you about your account and services

data_protection.title: Data protection
data_protection.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

contact_info.title: Contact
contact_info.content: If you have questions about this privacy policy, you can contact us through our contact page

data_collection_descriptions.personal_desc: Name, email and password when you register.
data_collection_descriptions.documents_desc: Documents, flashcards, quizzes and all content you generate.
data_collection_descriptions.usage_desc: Interactions, usage time, pages visited and features used.
data_collection_descriptions.technical_desc: Device type, browser, operating system and IP address.
